column1: Early Extraction Locations

column5:
Early Extractions become available for use after 8 minutes for everyone alive.
(Taking an early extract forfeits character xp, credits, and only gives you the account xp for objectives you were around for.)

The locations are static and thus far:
Pottsville has 3 Hatches
Lewiston has 3 Hatches
Power Plant has 7 Hatches
Broadway has 3 Hatches
Beaulieu has 1 Hatch

Open the hatch, go down the ladder, close the door and wait 10s to extract
